category: Basic SQL: Selection & Projection (Relational Algebra: σ and π)
title: Select Operational DC Fast Chargers
description: Projection of charger details with Selection condition charger_type LIKE '%DC%' and status = 'Operational'
sql:
SELECT charger_name, charger_type, power_output_kw, rate_per_kwh 
FROM chargers 
WHERE charger_type LIKE '%DC%' AND status = 'Operational' 
ORDER BY power_output_kw DESC;

title: Stations in Bengaluru with Rating >= 4.7
description: Select high-rated stations located specifically in Bengaluru

title: Multi-Table Join: Stations, Chargers, and Slots
description: Performs an Inner Join across 3 relations to display each physical slot alongside its charger specifications and station host
sql:
SELECT 
    s.name AS station_name,
    s.city,
    c.charger_name,
    c.power_output_kw || ' kW' AS power,
    c.connector_type,
    sl.slot_number,
    sl.status AS slot_status
FROM stations s
INNER JOIN chargers c ON s.station_id = c.station_id
INNER JOIN slots sl ON c.charger_id = sl.charger_id
ORDER BY s.city, s.name, sl.slot_number;

title: Left Outer Join: Active Station Overview & Available Bay Count
description: Uses LEFT JOIN and conditional aggregation to ensure stations with 0 available slots are still included in output
sql:
SELECT 
    s.station_id,
    s.name AS station_name,
    s.city,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.charger_id) AS total_chargers,
    COUNT(sl.slot_id) AS total_slots,
    SUM(CASE WHEN sl.status = 'Available' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS available_slots
FROM stations s
LEFT JOIN chargers c ON s.station_id = c.station_id
LEFT JOIN slots sl ON c.charger_id = sl.charger_id
GROUP BY s.station_id, s.name, s.city
ORDER BY available_slots DESC;

title: Stations with High Power Capacity (HAVING SUM > 100 kW)
description: Aggregates total kilowatt capacity per station and filters for rapid charging hubs delivering over 100 kW
sql:
SELECT 
    s.name AS station_name,
    s.city,
    COUNT(c.charger_id) AS charger_count,
    SUM(c.power_output_kw) AS total_kw_capacity,
    ROUND(AVG(c.rate_per_kwh), 2) AS avg_rate_per_kwh
FROM stations s
JOIN chargers c ON s.station_id = c.station_id
GROUP BY s.station_id, s.name, s.city
HAVING SUM(c.power_output_kw) >= 100
ORDER BY total_kw_capacity DESC;

title: Revenue and Energy Analytics by User
description: Aggregates completed charging sessions, total energy consumed in kWh, and total expenditure per customer
sql:
SELECT 
    u.name AS driver_name,
    u.email,
    COUNT(b.booking_id) AS total_sessions,
    ROUND(SUM(b.energy_needed_kwh), 1) AS total_energy_kwh,
    ROUND(SUM(p.amount), 2) AS total_spend_inr
FROM users u
JOIN bookings b ON u.user_id = b.user_id
JOIN payments p ON b.booking_id = p.booking_id
WHERE b.status = 'Completed' AND p.payment_status = 'Completed'
GROUP BY u.user_id, u.name, u.email
ORDER BY total_spend_inr DESC;

title: Subquery with IN: Drivers with High-Capacity Batteries (>40 kWh)
description: Finds users who own an electric vehicle having battery capacity greater than 40 kWh using an uncorrelated subquery
sql:
SELECT user_id, name, phone, email, wallet_balance
FROM users
WHERE user_id IN (
    SELECT user_id 
    FROM vehicles 
    WHERE battery_capacity_kwh >= 40.0
);

title: Correlated Subquery with EXISTS: Stations with at least 1 Available Slot
description: Uses EXISTS condition evaluated per station to find stations that currently have available parking bays
sql:
SELECT s.station_id, s.name, s.city, s.operator_name
FROM stations s
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 
    FROM chargers c
    JOIN slots sl ON c.charger_id = sl.charger_id
    WHERE c.station_id = s.station_id AND sl.status = 'Available'
);

title: Relational Union: All Connector Formats in Bengaluru vs Mumbai
description: Combines distinct connector types deployed in two major metropolitan grids
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT c.connector_type, 'Bengaluru' AS city
FROM chargers c
JOIN stations s ON c.station_id = s.station_id
WHERE s.city = 'Bengaluru'
UNION
SELECT DISTINCT c.connector_type, 'Mumbai' AS city
FROM chargers c
JOIN stations s ON c.station_id = s.station_id
WHERE s.city = 'Mumbai';

title: Query Pre-defined View: Station Overview
description: Queries the database view 'vw_station_overview' created during DDL execution
sql:
SELECT station_name, city, total_chargers, total_slots, available_slots, min_rate, max_power_kw
FROM vw_station_overview
WHERE available_slots > 0
ORDER BY available_slots DESC;

title: Inspect Automatic Trigger Audit Trail
description: Displays records created automatically by triggers (trg_audit_booking_insert, trg_slot_freed)
sql:
SELECT log_id, action_type, entity_name, entity_id, details, performed_at 
FROM audit_logs 
ORDER BY log_id DESC 
LIMIT 15;

title: EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN: Booking Search Optimization
description: Examines the SQLite Query Planner to demonstrate index usage on bookings(slot_id, start_time)
relationalAlgebra: EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN for Slot Conflict Checking
sql:
EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN 
SELECT booking_id, slot_id, start_time, end_time 
FROM bookings 
WHERE slot_id = 4 AND start_time < '2026-10-03 18:00:00' AND end_time > '2026-10-03 16:30:00';
